issues.message: Oxford 未出现在实际取得的材料中，Cambridge 未取得词条正文；原稿却主要挂接这两项来源。应改引实际可用的英语 Wiktionnaire 词条；超出其内容的专业用法说明不强挂该来源。
所比较的 come along 和 walk along 都没有直接宾语，不能清楚展示介词与副词的区别。
沿线静态位置与分布也是常用功能。现有说明侧重移动和延伸，宜明确补充，并加入直接展示沿线分布的例句。
常见的进展用法被混入向前移动义，又重复列为较少见义。应独立列入主要义项，并保留至少两个自然例句；be along with 也不能脱离 far、halfway 等程度成分笼统用作进度句型。
原英文句子可以成立，但表示完成程度的是 halfway along，with the project 引出任务，不能把 along with 整体解释为进展到某阶段。
along with 不限于出行或同行，也常连接一并包含的人或物。应补充非同行例句，并扩大现有结语的适用范围。
不能因为反向表达不适用全部句型，就将 contrasting 留空。同行可与 alone 对照；把东西带上可与 leave ... behind 对照，分别限定语境即可。
summary 中的 today 表述混乱，且遗漏材料已支持的与 long 的历史联系及中古英语传承。应直接写明可证实的历史，避免把现代拆字当作构词来源。

review.coverageAssessment: 已核对可用英语词条的“沿着”“向前”“一起”三类定义，并检查静态沿线分布、携带、along with 和常见进展用法。补丁后四组主要用法各有至少两个自然例句，进展不再列为较少见义。词源仅采用已取得的两项材料；进展等扩展按专业语言知识修订，不声称得到不可用网页的支持。含 along 的固定短语未作穷尽。

senseInventory.sense: 介词：沿着路线移动，或沿线延伸、定位和分布
senseInventory.assessment: 已有移动与延伸用例；补充明确的静态分布说明和例句后覆盖充分。
将原来的进度例句移至进展义，补入真正表示前行的第二例，并移出进展搭配。

senseInventory.sense: 副词及相关表达：随同、一起、把某物带上；along with 表示连同
senseInventory.assessment: 保留同行与携带两例，补充不涉及同行的 along with 用例，并分别给出适用的反向表达。

senseInventory.sense: 常见扩展：事情进展，或已进行到某一阶段
senseInventory.assessment: 由原有混合内容整理为主要义项，三个例句分别展示完成一半、询问完成程度和进展顺利。

patches.expectedValueJson: "沿用历史不是把现代字母 a 和 long 简单拼起来；沿线、前进和同行是历史发展出的相关用法。"

independentReview.method: Read the complete 10-unit root candidate, root author/source record and cached historical sources; independently open reference pages; make documented limited clarifications and re-read all changed fields. No new CLI model review was run.

sectionsRead: all ten definitions, usage notes, examples/translations, patterns and collocations
every similar/contrasting expression and its boundary note
both confusion groups and all four examples

assessment.grouping: Ten teaching units distinguish concrete preposition uses, adverb uses and whole phrasal/idiomatic expressions. Position and distributed-route examples are not identical functions. The added phrasal units do not claim that along alone means agreement or friendship.
assessment.relatedExpressions: No universal opposite is invented. across/back/alone/leave behind/without/no progress/disagree/disappear are explicitly restricted to their local contexts; all along has a contextual newly-discovered contrast rather than a fabricated dictionary antonym.
assessment.etymology: The inherited Old English history and long relation are supported. The mnemonic is explicitly not etymology. Alongside now has dedicated formation and usage sources.
requiredIssuesResolved: Clear travel destination in I went along with my sister to the library prevents the agreement interpretation.
The particular-point definition no longer requires farther-ahead position.
An idiomatic advanced-progress example replaces the awkward halfway along with project example.
Dedicated alongside sources replace an unrelated synonym-list citation for formation.
Candidate editorial status is draft until root publishes; the historical model status is not a substitute.

limitations: Not a claim to cover every specialized or less common phrasal expression containing along.
No audio audition; pronunciation is a textual source check.
This is an independent AI-agent content review, not human-teacher certification.

rootReview.reviewer: root Codex editor; not a human teacher
rootReview.method: Authored 10-unit expansion after reading original lesson and six actual dictionary pages; read independent full-review result and each final change against the candidate
observations: Particular-point definition does not imply farther-ahead in every context.
Explicit destination separates travel go along with from agreement.
Well along describes progress without asserting completion.
Whole expressions are distinguished from the meaning of along alone.
No fixed antonym invented for all along or a particular point; counterparts remain limited to relevant examples.
Dedicated alongside historical and modern sources are in independent-source-evidence.json and will be retained in publication audit.
